messages:
Anna: Postmortem is up for the intermittent rollup regressions — missing spans + odd aggregation spikes. Root cause looks like a race in the ETL windowing + out-of-order span dedupe. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/rollup-regressions-2147 :eyes:
Sam: ack. I'll own the aggregator patch to make the dedupe idempotent. ETA: today EOD.
Devon: I can own the backfill for the affected windows (2024-08-01..2024-08-07). Planning a staged backfill tomorrow night. Need Sam's patch to land first.
Luca: I'll add a regional health metric for the rollup completeness and a synthetic job to exercise the path. Quick alert tweak: lower alert sensitivity to avoid alert storms.
Anna: reading. Can we capture action items + owners with due dates?
Sam: Action: patch aggregator dedupe. Owner: Sam. Due: 2147937600 (tomorrow 03:00 UTC). Short PR template:
```
fix: make dedupe idempotent in aggregator
- add sequence checks
- add unit test for OOO spans
```
Devon: Action: staged backfill + validation. Owner: Devon. Due: 2148024000 (48h). Will coordinate with infra for capacity.
Luca: Action: monitoring + synthetic generator. Owner: Luca. Due: 2147923200 (tomorrow noon UTC). I'll post test data results here.
observability-bot: Created task OBS-4723 (aggregation-dedupe-patch) assigned to Sam; created task OBS-4724 (rollup-backfill) assigned to Devon; created task OBS-4725 (rollup-coverage-metrics) assigned to Luca.
Sam: quick note: reproducer query below — helps narrow the window
```
SELECT span_id, count(*) as cnt
FROM spans_raw
WHERE trace_ts BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-08-07'
GROUP BY span_id
HAVING cnt > 1;
```
Devon: validation plan: run the backfilled window through `rollup_validate` and compare coverage delta, then ship patch to prod once delta < 0.1%.
Anna: good. If anyone is blocked escalate to me. We'll have a sync in 24h in #incidents — mark progress in Jira tasks.
Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/845 — requesting review from @luca @tia
Luca: reviewing now, left a nit. Also added local fuzz test to synthetic generator.
Tia: FYI I updated the runbook section 'rollup-backfill' with steps + safe abort.
Devon: Backfill scheduled for 2024-08-06 01:00 UTC. Will post logs and validation results here.
Sam: Patch merged at 2147859000. Rolling patch to prod with canary.
observability-bot: Deployment notice: canary rollout started for service=aggregator env=prod at 2147860200
Luca: Canary looks stable, no error spike. Metrics: completeness improved from 96.2% -> 99.8% on sample.
Devon: Backfill completed. Validation: coverage delta 0.03%. Marking OBS-4724 resolved.
Anna: thanks team. I'll close the postmortem follow-up and keep a fortnightly watchlist for recurrence. If pattern repeats we'll schedule deep-dive.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Luca: :party_parrot:
